CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
      version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      applied_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      display_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      theme VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
      time_zone VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
      currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS personal_profile (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      legal_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      preferred_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      dob VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      ssn_enc TEXT NULL,
      drivers_license_enc TEXT NULL,
      current_phone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      current_email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      notes TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phone_history (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      profile_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
      phone_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
      label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Mobile',
      start_date VARCHAR(20) NULL,
      end_date VARCHAR(20) NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      profile_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
      email_address VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Personal',
      start_date VARCHAR(20) NULL,
      end_date VARCHAR(20) NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contacts (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      birthday VARCHAR(20) NULL,
      phone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      relationship VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      is_emergency INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      is_family INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      notes TEXT NOT NULL,
      search_text TEXT NOT NULL,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      label VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
      holder_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      dob VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      phone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,

    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_accounts (
      id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
      institution_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cards (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (

      ip_address VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
      deleted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_state (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_queue (

        entity_table VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
        entity_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
        operation VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL,

        next_retry_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
        last_error TEXT NULL,
        created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
        synced_at VARCHAR(40) NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_queue_pending ON sync_queue(synced_at, next_retry_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_start_at ON events(start_at)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_links_event_id ON event_links(event_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_links_target ON event_links(target_type, target_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reminders_remind_at ON reminders(remind_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contacts_updated_at ON contacts(updated_at)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_list_items_list_id ON list_items(list_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journal_entries_date ON journal_entries(entry_date)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_created_at ON audit_log(created_at)
